properties.name: onion.cache.invalidation.redis.enabled
properties.description: Enable Redis Pub/Sub cross-instance cache invalidation.

properties.name: security.default-algorithm
properties.description: Default request encryption algorithm. Set to non-NONE to enforce encryption.

properties.name: security.aes-secret-key
properties.description: AES secret key (Base64 encoded, 32 bytes). Auto-generated at startup if not set.

properties.name: security.aes-hmac-key
properties.description: AES HMAC key for integrity verification (Base64 encoded, 16 bytes). Auto-generated at startup if not set.

properties.name: security.rsa-public-key
properties.description: RSA public key (Base64 encoded). Auto-generated at startup if not set.

properties.name: security.rsa-private-key
properties.description: RSA private key (Base64 encoded). Auto-generated at startup if not set.

properties.name: security.tenant-id.machine-id
properties.description: Machine ID for distributed ID generation (0-1023).

properties.name: security.tenant-id.time-mask
properties.description: Hex seed for Feistel round key derivation in TenantIdGenerator.

values.description: Enable cross-instance invalidation via Redis channel
